_owner: Cold email specialist thread. Edit wording here; the engine only fills {variables} with checked facts.
_rules: Every {variable} must come from the lead row or our own site check. A variant is used only when all its 'requires' facts exist. Keep each line under 240 characters (the QA gate rejects longer ones).

no_site.line: {shop} has {review_count} reviews at {rating} stars, which is a lot of happy customers.
I was looking at detailers in {city}, and {shop}'s {review_count} reviews at {rating} stars stood out.
I saw {shop} picked up a new Google review {recent_review}, on top of {review_count} at {rating} stars.

social_only.line: {shop} has {review_count} reviews at {rating} stars, but your Google listing sends people to {social_name} instead of a website.

has_site.line: I was looking at detailers in {city} and checked out {shop}'s site. One thing stood out: {flaw}.

flaws.no_prices: your site doesn't list prices, so people who want a quote have to call or message first
flaws.no_booking: there's no way to book or request a time on your site, so visitors have to call and hope you pick up
flaws.slow_mobile: your site takes a while to load on a phone, and most people looking up a detailer are on their phone
